summary: Members of the other party praise a few lines of the address and then name the one thing it left out.
realLife: Legislators from both parties in one state's capital gave short reactions to a governor's address, the other party welcoming a teacher raise, rural internet and a hate crimes bill while saying the speech fell short on the Capitol riot, taxes and relief. In a second state a senator said the address left out public transit.
